$comment: Committed brand configuration: shared hooks run from the brand root through run-hook.py. The permission rules protect the pinned method mount and allow the save-brain credential flow. Parker is the shared voice. Personal overrides belong in settings.local.json. Keep shared hook behavior aligned with .codex/config.toml; see parker-system/system/codex-support.md.
